These results indicated that WHAs with fully solid solution of Ni and Fe can be obtained via employing W – Ni – Fe nanocomposite powder even at a low sintering temperature of 1300 ◦C.

It was found that the W phase had good interfacial bonding with the γ -(Ni, Fe) matrix phase and the enhanced mechanical properties were mainly contributed by the small grain size and high ratio of phase boundary, which can significantly improve the storage capacity of dislocation.
